title: Lake Louise Moraine Lake and Castle Morning Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Unlike standard round-trip sightseeing tours, this one-way experience is designed for travelers moving from Calgary to Banff while still visiting Lake Louise and Moraine Lake. An experienced driver-guide will be on board to take care of the journey, ensure a smooth experience, and share information and commentary along the way. With convenient pickup options, Banff drop-off, scenic stops, bottled water, and time for photos and a short hike, this tour combines practical transportation with a memorable Rocky Mountain experience.
